findings.notes: Notary attestation statement extraction checked the compressed descriptor and layer size against the 10 MB payload limit but read the decompressed predicate into memory without a bound, so an attacker-supplied referrer artifact that compresses small and expands large could exhaust admission controller memory; fixed by reading layers through a shared helper that decompresses under a bounded decoder and caps the decompressed output at the same limit (on this branch as 87cc5f94b).

Notary signature blob fetching applied the same compressed-only size check and buffered the decompressed signature layer without a bound, giving the same memory-exhaustion path during image verification; fixed by the same bounded-decoder helper, which also covers the equivalent cosign bundle read, and by rejecting a signature manifest that declares no layers instead of indexing it and panicking (on this branch as 87cc5f94b).
